title: #Mozacademy and microbusinesses #teachtheweb
summary: Thinking about liberal licenses and the Mozilla Web Club curriculum. Great discussion on Git about the difference between free and open. Glad to see folks like David Ascher and Atul Varma recognizing the power of entrepreneurail activism.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Thinking about liberal licenses and the Mozilla Web Club curriculum. 

 

Great discussion on Git about the difference between free and open. Glad to see folks like David Ascher and Atul Varma recognizing the power of entrepreneurail activism.
